description: This file defines the FileSystemApi interface, specifying methods for file and directory operations such as selection, creation, reading, saving, and closing write streams, primarily used for abstracting file system interactions.

methods.name: selectDirectory(): Promise<DirectoryHandle | FileSystemNoSelection> selectDirectory
methods.description: Opens a directory selection dialog and returns a DirectoryHandle or a FileSystemNoSelection if none selected.

methods.name: selectFile(): Promise<FileHandleRead | FileSystemNoSelection> selectFile
methods.description: Opens a file selection dialog and returns a FileHandleRead or a FileSystemNoSelection if none selected.

methods.name: readFile( readFile
methods.description: Reads the contents of the specified file, invoking onBytes callback with chunks and indicating the last chunk.

methods.name: createDirectory(parentDirectory: DirectoryHandle, name: string): Promise<DirectoryHandle | Fil/ createDirectory
methods.description: Creates a new directory under the specified parent directory with the given name.

methods.name: createFile(directory: DirectoryHandle, name: string): Promise<FileHandleReadWrite | FileSystem/ createFile
methods.description: Creates a new file under the specified directory with the given name.

methods.name: saveBytes(file: FileHandleReadWrite, bytes: Uint8Array): Promise<'success' | 'failed'> saveBytes
methods.description: Saves bytes to the specified file; returns 'success' or 'failed'.

methods.name: saveString(file: FileHandleReadWrite, contents: string): Promise<'success' | 'failed'> saveString
methods.description: Saves string contents to the specified file; returns 'success' or 'failed'.

methods.name: closeFileWriteStream(file: FileHandleReadWrite): Promise<'success' | 'failed'> closeFileWriteStream
methods.description: Closes the write stream for a file; returns 'success' or 'failed'.
